description:
Print a photo at the exact size you asked for. Type 10 x 15 cm, 4 x 6 in, or any width and height you like — PrintExact places it on the paper at that exact size and prints it that way.

No more "why is my 5 x 7 cropped in half?" and no more prints that come out a few millimetres short.

EXACT SIZE, NOT A GUESS
• Type any width and height in mm, cm or inches
• Presets: 10 x 15, 13 x 18, 20 x 30, 4 x 6, 5 x 7, 8 x 10 and document sizes
• Lock the proportions, or set both sides freely
• A ruler along the sheet shows how big it really is

THE WHOLE PICTURE, NOT A CROP
• Fit — the whole photo inside your size, nothing cut off
• Fill — your size filled edge to edge
• Stretch — exactly the numbers you typed
• Drag the frame to choose what stays in the picture

BIG POSTERS FROM ORDINARY SHEETS
• Turn one photo into a poster spread over several A4 or Letter sheets
• 50 x 70 cm, 70 x 100 cm, A2, A1, A0, or a size of your own
• Overlap for gluing, cut marks and a small map of which sheet goes where
• You see how many sheets it will take before you print anything

PRINT OR EXPORT
• AirPrint straight from your iPhone
• Or export PDF, JPEG or PNG at the exact size and print it anywhere
• Several copies on one sheet, or fill the sheet with copies automatically

WHEN THE PRINTER IS OFF BY A MILLIMETRE
Some printers quietly scale everything down. Print the calibration page once, measure the line with a ruler, type what you measured — and every print after that comes out true to size.

PROJECTS
Pages are saved as projects. Open one tomorrow, change the size, print it again.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
Everything happens on your iPhone. No account, no cloud, no ads, no subscription, no internet needed.

SIMPLE PRICING
The first three prints or exports are free. One purchase unlocks everything forever.

PrintExact is for anyone who needs the print to be the size they asked for: photos for frames and albums, document photos, sewing and craft templates, model plans, stencils and wall art.

DayLine is a one line a day journal and 5 year diary: write one sentence about your day in 20 seconds, and next year on the same date it shows you what you wrote. Writing is free every day with no limits, one purchase unlocks your whole journal, no subscription. Works offline in 45 languages.

DayLine is the journal you'll actually keep. Write a single line about your day, and next year, on the same date, it shows you what you wrote. Your years stack up, one honest sentence at a time.

WHY IT WORKS
• One line takes 20 seconds, so the habit survives busy days
• "On this day" brings back what you wrote a year ago, and the year before that
• A gentle reminder at the time you choose. If you already wrote today, it stays quiet

ON THIS DAY
Open the app on any date and see the same date from your past years right under today's line. A birthday, a first day at work, an ordinary Tuesday you would have forgotten. This is what a paper five year diary does, without carrying the book around.

CALENDAR AND TIMELINE
The calendar shows which days have a line, month by month. The timeline is your journal as one long scroll. Tap any day to read it again.

WIDGET
Put today's line on your Home Screen. The medium widget also shows what you wrote one year ago.

WHO IT IS FOR
• You tried journaling and quit because a blank page asked too much
• You want a 5 year diary that fits in your pocket
• You keep a gratitude journal and one good thing a day is enough
• You have one minute, not twenty

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your iPhone. No account, no cloud, no analytics, no ads. Lock the app with Face ID. Back up and restore your journal anytime.

SIMPLE PRICING
Free forever: write every day with no limits, your last 30 days, On this day, reminders, the widget and backup. One purchase unlocks your whole journal, every year, plus export as text. No subscription.

DayLine speaks 45 languages.

Big friendly timers. One step at a time. No pressure.

Routine Timer is a visual timer for kids and grown-ups who get stuck between steps. Morning, homework, cleanup, bedtime: any routine becomes a sequence of visual steps, each with its own full-screen timer. A big color ring shrinks as the minutes pass, and a gentle tap says it is time to move on.

MADE FOR REAL LIFE
• Build a routine from steps: an icon and a duration, nothing else to set up
• One giant timer per step, readable from across the room
• A haptic nudge on every transition, and a notification with sound when the screen is off
• Pause, skip, go back or restart any step. No streaks, no guilt, no failure stats
• Notifications keep the routine going while the phone is locked

PERFECT FOR
• Morning routine before school, bedtime routine after the bath
• Homework blocks and focus sprints
• Toddlers and preschoolers learning to get ready on their own
• Kids with ADHD or autism who do better with a schedule they can see
• Cleanup bursts, chores and screen-time limits

WHY IT WORKS
A child cannot feel ten minutes, but can see a color ring getting smaller. Steps take the arguing out of transitions: the timer says it is time, not the parent. Grown-ups use it the same way for their own mornings and work sprints.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your iPhone. No account, no cloud, no analytics, no ads. Works offline.

SIMPLE PRICING
Your first routine is free, full featured, forever: every step, sounds and notifications. One purchase unlocks unlimited routines. No subscription, nothing recurring. If you already unlocked the app, nothing changes for you.

The GLP-1 diary that stays on your phone. No account, no subscription, no ads.

GLP-1 Log keeps your weekly or daily shots in one place: which medicine, what dose, where you injected, and when the next one is due. Three taps and the shot is logged.

LOG A SHOT IN SECONDS
• Medicine and dose are remembered from last time
• Tap the spot on the body map: belly, thigh or upper arm, left or right
• The app suggests the next spot so you rotate instead of guessing
• Mark when you start a new pen and see how many doses are left

SEE YOUR NEXT SHOT
• Countdown to shot day and a reminder on the day
• A heads-up when your pen is running low

TRACK WHAT MATTERS
• Weekly weight in kg or lb
• Side effects with how strong they were: nausea, tiredness, stomach pain and more
• Charts for weight, dose over time and side effects

FOR YOUR DOCTOR
• Export a clean PDF report or a CSV file before your appointment

WORKS WITH
Semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide, dulaglutide, oral GLP-1 tablets, or add your own medicine.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything is stored on your iPhone. Lock the app with Face ID. Save a backup file when you change phones.

SIMPLE PRICING
The first 4 injections and 30 days are free. One purchase unlocks everything forever. No subscription.

WHO IT'S FOR
• Anyone on a weekly or daily GLP-1 shot who wants one clear record
• People who keep forgetting which side they injected last time
• Anyone whose doctor asks: how is the weight going, any side effects?
Nothing to set up and no account: open the app on shot day and log it.

GLP-1 Log is a diary. It does not give medical advice and never suggests doses. Your prescriber decides your treatment.

Bills arrive on their own schedule. One always slips past you, and you find out when the late fee lands.

Put a bill in once: name, amount, the date it is due, how often it repeats. After that the phone keeps the dates.

REMINDERS BEFORE THE DATE, NOT AFTER
A notification comes on the due date. Add earlier ones if you need a few days to move money. You set the time of day once and every bill uses it.

ONE TAP WHEN YOU PAY
Tap the checkmark. The payment drops into History and the bill rolls forward to its next date by itself. A one time bill goes to the archive instead. Nothing gets deleted.

THE MONTH IN ONE SCREEN
Upcoming splits your bills into overdue, due this week, and later. At the top: how much is still to pay this month, and how much is already paid.

STAYS ON THIS IPHONE
No account, no cloud, no ads, no analytics. Rent, power, insurance, loan payments: none of it leaves the phone. Works with no internet at all.

45 LANGUAGES AND YOUR CURRENCY
Both are in Settings, along with the time of day your reminders arrive.

ONE PRICE, PAID ONCE
Three bills with their reminders, one-tap payments and 30 days of history are free and stay free. One purchase lifts the limit for good: unlimited bills and full payment history, with no subscription and nothing to renew. Whatever you have already entered is yours either way.

trackName: Sugar Log XL — Blood Sugar Log
description:
The blood sugar journal made for seniors, and for everyone who hates squinting.

Sugar Log XL does one thing well: it keeps your glucose readings in giant, readable numbers. Log a reading in seconds with one big wheel, tag it (fasting, before or after a meal, bedtime), and show your doctor a clean history.

WHAT YOU CAN LOG
• Fasting glucose in the morning
• Readings before and after meals
• Bedtime readings
• Any value from any glucose meter: the app is a diary, not a device

WHO IT IS FOR
• People with type 2 or type 1 diabetes who test at home
• Prediabetes and gestational diabetes, when the doctor asks for a log
• Sons and daughters helping a parent keep their numbers in order
• Anyone replacing a paper logbook with something that fits in a pocket

DAY AND NIGHT
Light and dark mode with the same giant numbers. Readable on the nightstand at 6 a.m. and in the kitchen at noon.

MADE TO BE EASY
• Giant numbers and big buttons on every screen
• Log a reading in seconds: the wheel remembers your last value
• mg/dL or mmol/L, match your meter in one tap
• Clear history, newest first
• Backup and restore all your readings from Settings, free

FOR YOUR DOCTOR
Export every reading as a simple CSV report your doctor can read at a glance.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your iPhone. No account, no cloud, no analytics, no ads.

SIMPLE PRICING
Your first 14 days open everything. After that, logging, your last 7 days and backup stay free forever. One purchase unlocks your full history and the doctor report, forever. No subscription. If you already unlocked the app, nothing changes for you.

Sugar Log XL is a journal. It does not measure blood sugar and does not give medical advice.

Pocket Money is the allowance tracker for parents who pay their kids in cash. Log weekly allowance, chores with a reward, gifts and spending, and see every child's balance at a glance. No bank card, no account, no internet needed.

WHAT IT DOES
• One tap to add allowance, a chore reward or a gift
• Weekly allowance is credited automatically, even after a week away from the app
• Chores with a price: tap Done and the money lands in the child's balance
• Savings goals with a progress bar for the bike, the game or the trip
• A clear history for every child: who got what, when and why
• Every child gets a card with balance, saved amount and weekly allowance

WHY PARENTS LIKE IT
Cash is still the easiest way to teach kids about money, but paper notes get lost and nobody remembers who owes what. Pocket Money keeps the ledger so the pocket money itself can stay in the piggy bank. Kids see their balance grow, learn that chores earn money and that saving takes time.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your iPhone. No bank card, no account, no cloud, no ads, no analytics.

SIMPLE PRICE
The first 14 days open everything. After that, the Notebook is free forever: one child, one savings goal, up to 3 chores, entries by hand and your last 30 days. Logging money is never blocked. One family purchase unlocks every child and every goal, automatic pocket money and full history with CSV export. No subscription.

WORKS EVERYWHERE
Choose any currency and any of 34 languages, independent of your iPhone settings. Light and dark mode.

Pocket Money is a private ledger for cash. It is not a bank and does not move real money.

Reading Log XL is a reading log and book tracker: it records reading minutes, pages and books, and makes a one page PDF reading report for the teacher. Pay once, no subscription.

ONE BUTTON A DAY
Tap "I read today", pick the minutes, save. A built-in timer counts a reading session for you if you want it to.

YOUR BOOKSHELF
Keep three shelves — reading now, finished, want to read. Title, author, page count, a coloured spine instead of a cover. No sign-up, no social feed, no reviews to scroll.

A REPORT FOR SCHOOL
Make a one-page PDF for a teacher or a parent: days read, minutes, pages and the books behind them. Pick 7 days, 30 days, a year or everything.

GOALS AND STREAKS
Set a daily goal in minutes and watch the streak build. Weekly and monthly totals show whether the habit is holding.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Everything stays on your iPhone. No account, no cloud, no ads, no analytics. Works on a plane.

SIMPLE PRICE
The free version always saves everything you log and shows the last 30 days plus three books at a time. One purchase unlocks the full history, unlimited books and PDF reports forever. No subscription.

Track what you spend — in seconds, on your phone, without a subscription.

Expense Log XL is a manual expense tracker for people who want their money in their own hands: type the amount, tap a category, done. No bank logins, no accounts, no cloud, no ads.

AN EXPENSE IN 3 SECONDS
• A big numpad and big category buttons — one tap saves the expense
• 10 ready-made categories, or build your own with your own icons
• A note or a different date only when you actually need one

SEE WHERE THE MONEY GOES
• This month's total at a glance
• Every category with its share, as bars and percentages
• Swipe left or right to walk through your months
• Search your notes

CSV EXPORT THAT ACTUALLY WORKS
Date, Amount, Currency, Category, Note — a clean UTF-8 file with BOM that opens correctly in Excel, Numbers and Google Sheets. Commas and quotation marks inside your notes stay intact instead of breaking the columns.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your iPhone. No account, no server, no cloud sync, no analytics, no advertising. Your expenses are nobody else's business.

HONEST PRICING
Adding expenses is always free and never limited. Your first 14 days open everything. After that, the free version keeps this month in full, plus backup. One purchase unlocks every past month, CSV export of any period and one-tap recurring expenses. Forever, with no subscription.

The cholesterol log with big numbers. Your lipid panel results in one place: no account, no subscription, no ads.

Cholesterol Log XL is made for people who get a blood test a few times a year and want to keep the numbers without squinting. Copy Total, LDL, HDL and Triglycerides from your lab sheet, and the app keeps every result in a clean, large-print list.

LOG A PANEL IN SECONDS
• Four big fields, one big wheel: tap a value, turn the wheel, done
• Total is enough. Leave LDL, HDL or Triglycerides at “Not measured” if your sheet does not show them
• Add the test date and a short note: lab name, fasting
• Your last result is remembered, so the next entry takes a few turns of the wheel

SEE EVERY RESULT
• Your newest panel on top, printed like a lab slip with big numbers
• Older results below, newest first
• TC/HDL shown as a plain number, exactly as many lab sheets print it
• Tap any result to fix a number or delete it

FOR YOUR DOCTOR
• Share a clean text report of all your results
• Export a CSV file for a spreadsheet or your clinic
• Reports use the units you chose

YOUR UNITS
Pick mg/dL or mmol/L, whichever is printed on your lab sheet. Cholesterol and triglycerides are converted with their own correct factors. Switch anytime in Settings.

NEXT TEST REMINDER
Choose 1, 3, 6 or 12 months after your last result and get a reminder when it is time for the next blood test.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your iPhone. No account, no cloud, no analytics, no tracking. Delete the app and the data goes with it, so export a report first.

SIMPLE PRICING
The last three results are always free. One purchase unlocks your full history and the doctor's report forever. No subscription.

WHO IT'S FOR
• Anyone who checks cholesterol regularly and wants all the numbers in one place
• Older eyes: large print, high contrast, big buttons
• Anyone whose doctor asks “what were your numbers last time?”

Cholesterol Log XL is a journal. It does not test your blood, does not interpret your results and does not give medical advice. Always talk to your doctor about your health.

Debt Payoff XL is a debt snowball and avalanche planner: enter your credit cards, car loan and student loan once and see the month you will be debt free, with the interest each order costs. Pay once, no subscription: the first 3 debts are free forever and one purchase unlocks the rest. Works offline in 45 languages.

Splitting your spare money across everything feels fair, and it is exactly why nothing ever closes.

Enter each debt once: name, balance, annual rate, minimum payment. From there the app works out the order and the date.

SNOWBALL OR AVALANCHE
Smallest balance first, or highest rate first. The Plan screen runs both and shows what each order costs you in interest. Pick the one you will actually stick with.

THE DATE YOU ARE WORKING TOWARD
The plan is a month by month simulation of your own numbers. Raise the extra payment a little and the finish date moves while you watch.

ONE DEBT AT A TIME
Minimums go to everything, and whatever is left goes into a single debt until it is gone. That debt then hands its whole payment, minimum included, to the next one in line. Your monthly total never changes, it just lands on one target.

WHEN THE MINIMUM IS TOO SMALL
If the minimum does not cover the monthly interest, that balance grows instead of shrinking. The app says so on the debt itself instead of drawing a nicer chart.

LOG A PAYMENT AND WATCH IT DROP
Tap the debt, enter what you paid. The balance falls, History keeps the record, and the chart shows your total debt going down month by month.

REMINDERS
Each debt has its own day of the month. The time of day is set once and used by all of them.

STAYS ON THIS IPHONE
No account, no cloud, no ads, no analytics. Balances and rates do not leave the phone. It works with no internet at all.

45 LANGUAGES AND YOUR CURRENCY
Both are in Settings, and only the symbol changes. Nothing is converted.

ONE PRICE, PAID ONCE
Your first three debts are free for as long as you want them. One purchase lifts the limit for good, with no subscription and nothing to renew. Whatever you have entered is yours either way.

Hot flash tracker and menopause symptom log. Every hot flash, with the time it actually happened. Pay once, no subscription.

Most menopause apps only let you say "I had hot flashes today". That is not what your doctor needs to see. Meno Log saves each flash as its own moment: tap the circle, choose how strong it was, done. Two taps, exact time — and you can correct the time later for the one that woke you at three in the morning.

LOGGED IN TWO TAPS
• One big button for a hot flash — the time is saved for you
• Nine more symptoms: night sweats, sleep, mood, brain fog, headache, fatigue, palpitations, joint pain, plus your own
• Three levels of intensity, an optional note, full edit and delete

YOUR DAY AND YOUR NIGHT
History shows every day with flashes split into daytime and night, so the pattern is visible at a glance.

A REPORT IN A MINUTE
Two weeks, one month or three months — share it as text or as a CSV file your doctor can open in any spreadsheet.

NO ACCOUNT. NO CLOUD.
No sign-up, no server, no ads, no analytics. Everything stays on this iPhone.

ONE PAYMENT, NOT A SUBSCRIPTION
Logging is never limited. Your first 14 days open everything; after that, today and your last 7 days stay free forever. One purchase unlocks your full history and doctor reports forever.

Meno Log is a personal journal. It does not diagnose, does not interpret your entries and does not give medical or treatment advice. For anything about your health, talk to your doctor.

You draw on real paper, not on the screen. Lucida Cam shows your picture over the live camera view of your page, and you trace it with a pencil. One purchase. No subscription, no ads, no account.

HOW IT WORKS
Put the iPhone on a stack of books, screen up, so the end with the camera sticks out over the paper. Put a small book on top to hold it. Slide your hand with a pencil under the phone, look at the screen and follow the lines you see. A phone stand works too. The phone stays still, so the picture stays in place while you draw.

Lucida Cam is a trace projector and AR drawing tool in the spirit of the camera lucida, the optical aid artists used long before phones.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Trace a photo, a sketch or one of the built-in sample pictures onto paper.
• Set how visible the picture is, so you see both the lines and your pencil.
• Turn a photo into clean lines with the Outline, Sketch and Black & White filters.
• Choose black, white or yellow lines. White lines work well on dark paper.
• Mirror the picture when you need a flipped copy, for example for a stamp.
• Lock the screen so a stray touch can’t move the picture.
• Adjust size, rotation and position with buttons, in small or large steps.
• Turn on the flashlight when the room is dim.

GRID MODE, NO CAMERA NEEDED
Draw square by square, the classic way. Lucida Cam puts a labeled grid over your picture and shares the picture with the grid so you can print it. Draw the same squares on paper and copy one square at a time.

WHO IT IS FOR
• Hobby artists and students who want the reference right on the page.
• Parents and kids tracing pictures together.
• Tattoo artists preparing a stencil drawing on paper.
• Anyone who wants to copy a picture by hand and learn to draw along the way.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• Pictures and projects stay on your iPhone. The app works offline and has no server.
• The camera view is never recorded.
• Every project is saved with its position, size and settings.
• Works with large text and VoiceOver.

GOOD TO KNOW
Lucida Cam does not project light onto the paper and does not use ARKit or AI. You look at the screen and draw on the paper under the phone. For a sharp view keep the phone about 20 cm (8 in) above the page. iPhone models with a close-focus camera can sit much lower.

Pay once and keep it.

trackName: BP Log XL — Blood Pressure Log
description:
Blood pressure log with big numbers, made for seniors. Log systolic, diastolic and pulse in seconds and show your doctor a clear history. Pay once, no subscription.

BP Log XL does one thing perfectly: it keeps your blood pressure readings in giant, readable numbers. Log a measurement in seconds with three big wheels, see your latest reading from across the room, and show your doctor a clean history.

MADE TO BE EASY
• Giant numbers and big buttons on every screen
• Log systolic, diastolic and pulse in seconds — wheels remember your last values
• Clear history, newest first

FOR YOUR DOCTOR
Export all your readings as a simple report your doctor can read at a glance.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your iPhone. No account, no cloud, no analytics, no ads.

SIMPLE PRICING
Your first 14 days open everything. After that, logging, your last 7 days and backup stay free forever. One purchase unlocks your full history, 30- and 90-day trends and CSV export, forever. No subscription. If you already unlocked the app, nothing changes for you.

BP Log XL is a journal. It does not measure blood pressure and does not give medical advice.
